text.t:
The ithos®️ wooden children's lamp, with the delicate shape of a hot air balloon, combines timeless design, cosy light and the charm of small details. Its warm white LED lighting creates a soft and comforting atmosphere, ideal for accompanying moments of reading, tranquillity and snugness before sleep, as well as being the perfect companion for a protected night for little ones.

During the day, it serves as a decorative piece that adds personality and tenderness to a child's room. With careful finishes and hand-painted details, it integrates harmoniously into any setting, with soft woods and neutral tones.
Created to make rest moments even sweeter and more special.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are included. The cable version comes with a remote control: on, off, dimming, auto-off and a slow pulsing light effect.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, engraved on the wood. Leave blank if you prefer no engraving.
